dedupe_keys.name: compilation of the nuclear industry s gaseous radiocarbon 14c emissions 1950 2023

description: This data set compiles worldwide gaseous radiocarbon (14C) emissions from nuclear facilities, split into inorganic, organic and total, from 1950 to 2023. It was published by Thomas Laemmel, Timo Knaack, Andrea Heckel, Angelina Wenger and Sönke Szidat. It combines the European Commission Radioactive Discharges Database (RADD), the IAEA DIRATA database, reports of UNSCEAR and the IAEA, publications and many plant-specific annual environmental reports. Coverage is nuclear power plants and fuel reprocessing plants in 22 countries including Argentina, Canada, China, France, Germany, Japan, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, the United Kingdom and the United States, mostly as annual values with monthly, quarterly or weekly values for some sites such as La Hague, Sellafield and Swedish and Swiss plants. The data are 17 CSV files on Zenodo (March 2025) under CC-BY-4.0 at no cost, with sources noted in a comments column. Caveats: coverage and reporting frequency vary by country and period, and some values come from secondary reports. Simulation uses are environmental impact assessment of nuclear plants and atmospheric transport studies. Related records: data-corso-nuclear-14co2-gridded-emissions gives gridded fluxes built from similar sources.
